name: India DPDP Act 2023
description: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — operational SecuraIQ control pack covering fiduciary duties, children's data, Significant Data Fiduciary obligations (conditional), Data Principal rights, and breach-related duties. Use with dpdp_rules_2025 for procedural detail and phased commencement.
legal_disclaimer: SecuraIQ produces an evidence-backed readiness assessment for authorised labs and customer-owned systems — not a determination that an organisation is legally 'DPDP compliant'. Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) status and other applicability questions require human/legal review against the Act, Rules, and the organisation's circumstances. Official source of truth: MeitY / Gazette of India.

resources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (MeitY)
resources.note: Primary statute. Confirm current commencement notifications before treating any section as enforceable.

controls.title: Grounds for processing personal data
controls.description: Process personal data only for a lawful purpose under the Act (consent or legitimate use).

controls.title: Notice for consent-based processing
controls.description: Before seeking consent, give the Data Principal the notice required by the Act/Rules.

controls.title: Legitimate uses
controls.description: Document when processing relies on a legitimate use rather than consent.

controls.title: Consent withdrawal and effect
controls.description: Enable withdrawal of consent with ease comparable to giving consent; cease processing that depended on that consent.

controls.title: General obligations of Data Fiduciary
controls.description: Implement organisational/technical measures: purpose limitation, data accuracy, security safeguards, erasure when purpose ends (unless retention required by law).

controls.title: Processing of personal data of children
controls.description: Obtain verifiable parental/guardian consent before processing a child's personal data; observe restrictions on tracking/behavioural monitoring and targeted advertising.

controls.title: Additional obligations of Significant Data Fiduciary
controls.description: If notified/classified as SDF: appoint DPO, appoint independent data auditor, undertake DPIA and periodic audits as required.

controls.title: Right to access information
controls.description: Provide Data Principals a means to obtain a summary of personal data being processed and of processing activities.

controls.title: Right to correction and erasure
controls.description: Enable correction, completion, updating, and erasure of personal data as provided under the Act.

controls.title: Right of grievance redressal
controls.description: Publish and operate a grievance redressal mechanism for Data Principals.

controls.title: Right to nominate
controls.description: Allow Data Principals to nominate another individual to exercise rights in case of death or incapacity.

controls.title: Duties of Data Principal
controls.description: Ensure request workflows discourage false statements / impersonation and record identity assurance steps.

controls.title: Transfer of personal data outside India
controls.description: Do not transfer personal data to countries/territories restricted by the Central Government.

controls.title: Engagement of Data Processor
controls.description: Where a Data Processor is engaged, ensure processing is under a valid contract/arrangement and security obligations flow down.

controls.title: Personal data breach readiness (Act duties)
controls.description: Maintain capability to detect, assess, and intimate personal data breaches as required once corresponding Rules apply.
